div.h3: Why do I need a Prescription?
div.p: All medications that are not over the counter require a direct prescription by our Doctor. Prescription medications are specially tailored for use by a specific person for specific use as they may cause different reactions in some individuals. Prescription medications require a medical diagnosis before they can be purchased at EHACLINICS. Using prescription medications unsupervised can lead to harm if misused, or abused.
